page.overview:
Who is Beachcomber?

Always vigilant, Beachcomber keeps his optics and audio receptors on full alert while on his usually guard duty for any signs of Decepticon activity and for any opportunity to crack a bad joke. Fellow Autobots might have to suffer the occasional lousy pun (is there any other kind?), but Decepticons get the puns AND missiles in the face. Night or day, Beachcomber is ready.
